decisions.reason: As a 2023 door lever handle family with no negative signal yet, it is still a low-cost option to keep open while the market reveals demand.
The mitred door lever handle family appears to be a somewhat more design-specific variant, but after only one year the uncertainty is still too high to justify abandonment.

The multifunctional door lever handle is likely the most experimental offer, so its risk of withdrawal is higher, but management would usually keep it on the market a bit longer to learn about acceptance.
A newly launched door lever handle with no clear failure signal would normally be retained because the option value of waiting exceeds the likely cost of keeping it listed.
This new door and window handle collection already has a strong positive signal through its own web presence and a 2023 German Design Award, so dropping it would be unlikely.
A new finish such as light patinated bronze is relatively inexpensive to maintain as a portfolio option, so the firm would likely keep it unless demand clearly disappoints.
